name: Lean MCP Server
description: MCP server providing Lean 4 diagnostics, proof state, and goal information. It does NOT require a local lean-toolchain: the Lean runs server-side and detection is an mcp-probe against the endpoint. It used to declare that requirement, which made it unavailable on any machine without a local Lean even when the server was reachable — and, because `lean-toolchain.fallbackTo` names this capability, made that fallback unable to fire at all (it was absent in exactly the case it existed for). Removed 2026-09-20, bean folio-assistant-sym3.
